description: List a post's comments: top-level comments newest first, each with its first replies. Pass parent_id to page through one comment's replies (oldest first). Use the returned nextCursor for the next page.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor: the previous page's nextCursor

parent_id.description: Optional: a top-level comment UUID, to list its replies

post_id.description: Post UUID (from get_feed, list_posts or list_tag_posts)

name: list_post_comments
